title: HELIX Bridge: Workday HCM → Payroll
architecture_notes: Workday Payroll is cloud-native with built-in tax engine (for US). Some institutions use Workday Payroll directly; others use a third-party payroll (ADP, Ceridian) and integrate via Payroll Interface. For institutions using third-party payroll, Workday exports payroll input and imports payroll results.

source_objects.description: Pay statement results: gross pay, taxes, deductions, net pay, by pay component. Equivalent to PS_PAY_EARNINGS + PS_PAY_DEDUCTION + PS_PAY_TAX + PS_PAY_CHECK.
Earnings type (regular, overtime, shift differential, stipend, retroactive) or deduction type (tax, benefit, garnishment, retirement).
One-time entries: bonuses, additional earnings, adjustments. Equivalent to PS_ADDL_PAY_ERNCD or PS_ONE_TIME_PAY.
W-2 data, tax jurisdiction, withholding elections. Equivalent to PS_FED_TAX_DATA + PS_STATE_TAX_DATA.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Sum of all earnings.

attribute_mappings.source: Sum of Payroll Result tax components
Sum of Payroll Result deduction components
attribute_mappings.transformation: Benefits + retirement + garnishments + other pre/post-tax deductions.
Base pay earnings for the period.

attribute_mappings.source: Sum of bonus, stipend, retroactive components
Sum of medical, dental, vision, life, etc. components

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX org code. Where the labor cost is charged.
Map to HELIX fund code. Grant-funded positions → restricted fund.
If labor is charged to a grant.

notes: Payroll data is restricted. Contains SSN-linked tax data, salary details, and garnishment information. W-2 data subject to IRS retention requirements. Higher ed payroll complexity: faculty 9-month vs 12-month pay distribution, summer research compensation, graduate assistant stipends with tuition remission, multi-fund labor distribution (split funding across grants and operating funds).
